description: One document answering what a supplier review, a customer security questionnaire and an EU AI Act technical file all ask about one repository: what ships and under which licence, what a model and the infrastructure are allowed to do, what breaks if it ships, and who approved it - with the measured precision and recall behind each claim, each naming the harness that re-derives it. A check that could not run says so in place of its answer, so no empty section reads as a clean one. There is no overall pass or fail: it reports what was established, what was not, and what is waiting on a person. No model is called and nothing is fetched. Use `quick` to skip the three whole-repository walks, which the document then names as skipped.

project.description: Absolute path of the project folder

quick.description: Skip the checks that read every source file; the document names each one it skipped

since.description: The git ref to compare API descriptions against, e.g. HEAD~1 or a tag

name: evidence_pack
title: The evidence pack for one repository
